analysis.purpose: A hand-rolled, dependency-free recursive-descent parser for the migration-relevant subset of PL/SQL: DDL, package specs and bodies, procedures and functions, anonymous blocks, DML, control flow and exception handlers.
responsibilities: Parse the supported subset into a typed top-level AST
Resynchronise to the next statement or block boundary on an unexpected token
Degrade unsupported constructs to a plain statement rather than failing

businessRules.rule: Tolerant by design: an unexpected token resyncs and the parse continues; the extractor never throws.
businessRules.rationale: One unparseable construct must not cost the whole file its symbols.

businessRules.rule: This is not a validating PL/SQL parser — constructs outside the subset degrade or are skipped.
businessRules.rationale: Stated honestly so nobody reads a clean parse as a syntax check.

nodes.name: PL/SQL parsing
nodes.summary: Tolerant subset parser for PL/SQL migration analysis.

edges.rationale: This file is the PL/SQL parser.
